#### PR description:

Fix the heterogeneous unit tests for `edmTypeInfo` for builds where CUDA or ROCm are not available.

#### PR validation:

Unit test now passes on `el9_amd64_gcc16` which does not have CUDA.


#### Backport status:

Backport of #51580.
title: [17.0] Update unit tests for `edmTypeInfo`
